system.description:
Also, at 6th Level, you learn a new molding called Combination Technique.

Combination Technique. You spend 2 Focus and command your Bonded creature to spend their reaction to embolden the jutsu cast. The Jutsu can gain the benefit of any Role effect or Special feature your summon has that would qualify if they had cast it themselves. If your Bonded creature has no such Role effect or Special feature that qualifies, then they can cast a D-Rank jutsu they know as part of this molding at no Jutsu slot cost. This becomes C-Rank at 14th level.
